name: Cessna Airmaster (C-34/C-37/C-38/C-145/C-165)
summary: Fast 1930s Cessna cabin monoplane with a strut-free wooden wing and a radial engine, the design that helped revive Cessna after the Depression.

wings: High cantilever wing with no struts
engines: Single radial engine (Warner Scarab) in a round, smooth cowl
fuselage: Narrow fabric-covered cabin with small windows
Streamlined fixed main gear, curved legs on the C-38, with a tailwheel
tail: Rounded fin and rudder, taller on the C-38

tellTales: 1930s strut-free high wing on a narrow, rounded cabin
Round radial cowl up front on a tailwheel airframe

confusedWith.howToTell: The 195 is a larger, boxier all-metal cabin plane with a taller swept fin and a bigger radial; the Airmaster is smaller, rounder and fabric-covered.
The 120/140 is a small two-seat strut-braced high-wing with a flat-four; the Airmaster is a strut-free radial-powered cabin plane.
The Reliant is strut-braced with a rounded radial; the Airmaster's wing has no struts.
